readings.title: Weak value amplification is suboptimal for estimation and detection
findings: p1-2 assumes weak-coupling expansion, broad Gaussian meter and specified Gaussian technical noise; weak values are initially taken real.
p3 Eq18-22 retains successful-outcome counts and compares specified estimators. Large conditional shift alone is not a complete estimation figure of merit.
Our phase-quotient classification and exact centered bound are separate analytic transfer checks. No metrology-to-classification theorem is imported.
limitations: No code, empirical reproduction, later detection proof or supplement audited. p4 start appeared in extraction preview but is not included in semantic receipt or relied on.
Version footer and document dateline differ; both retained, no claim of a new 2018 arXiv revision.
